mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.asset_id, r.user_id, r.action_type, r.old_status, r.new_status, r.audit_status, r.remark, r.create_time, u.nickname AS userNickname, a.asset_name AS assetName FROM bus_record r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN bus_asset a ON r.asset_id = a.id WHERE r.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
